_refunds: Share given back (0-1). cancel_refund_in_progress = cancelling the batch being made; cancel_refund_waiting = cancelling a batch still waiting in the queue; demolish_refund = share of the build cost back when demolishing.
_stats: Statistics graphs: a point is recorded every stats_sample_seconds while playing (one point covers time spent away), keeping the latest stats_history_size points (360 x 60s = 6 hours).
_workers: staffing_levels = share of a building's max_workers the player can choose (8 at level 1 -> Low 4, Medium 6, High 8). New buildings start at default_staffing. worker_types: wage_per_hour is paid for every worker actually working, including while the game is closed; cash may go below 0 (debt). available = false types can't be hired yet (high-skilled = high school graduates, professional = college graduates; they arrive with schools). All PLACEHOLDERS.

island._comment: Land around the buildable plot. margin = tiles of non-buildable land around the plot; coast_roughness / coast_frequency = how wobbly the coastline is; seed picks one fixed coastline (change it for a different shape); beaches = rough share of the coast that is sand instead of rock cliff (0-1); tree_density = how thick the placeholder forests are (0-1).
